notes: All motion duration, delay, easing, travel direction, loop and responsive travel rules are implementation proposals, not measured Figma keyframes or company-wide motion tokens.
The existing measured color stops, header border row and status appearance remain in chat-progress.figma.json. Written animation intent is distinct from measured timing.
Static ChatHeader remains the default. The product opts into thinking motion and owns request identity, current phase, elapsed time and stop/complete/error transitions.
Header motion remains decorative and does not report percentage, elapsed time, network success or business completion. ThinkingStatus provides readable status through one announcement owner.
Actual consuming source/export, browser motion fidelity, contrast alternatives and product adoption remain unverified/unmapped/draft until checked in that repository.
ThinkingStatus runtime adoption supersedes the earlier fixed 5-stop base plus single-band recipe. Raw Figma stops remain preserved for comparison; Header default static is unchanged.
